name: loopback_ports_1_1024_nmap_validated
description: TCP connect states for 127.0.0.1:1-1024, labeled by nmap as an INDEPENDENT implementation observing the same vantage.
labeling_note: Ground truth is nmap's remotely-observed state, not a local listener list, per accuracy.py's discipline. One <extraports state='closed' count='1023'> was expanded across the unlisted scanned ports (verified: the expansion filled exactly 1023 slots). Loopback is a degenerate vantage with no packet loss: this corpus validates the state MODEL and connect-path correctness and deliberately CANNOT exercise the AIMD congestion behaviour, which needs a lossy path.
